description: This file contains the implementation of the UserService interface, specifically the UserServiceImpl class, which interacts with the UserDao to perform CRUD operations on User objects.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: The implementation of UserService that utilizes UserDao for user data management.

methods.name: findUser
methods.description: Finds and returns a User object given a userId string.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user by saving the User object via UserDao.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user by saving the User object via UserDao.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user specified by userId.
